description: This file defines a class EmployeeLicenseSearchFilterParams which extends a base FilterParams class. It is used to encapsulate search filter parameters specific to employee licenses within the HRM system, including setting and retrieving an employee number and specifying allowed sort fields.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class used for filtering employee license search results, allowing setting of employee number and permitted sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter by setting the default sort field to 'el.licenseIssuedDate'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter as an integer.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter.
